name: Extend Data Services Permission Definition
description: Authorization for user access. The template's creator-scoped policies are deliberately absent: this is a single-household system in which the Runtime and the User work on the same Things. See DECISIONS.md D-010.

policies.name: User Has Actuator Path Access
policies.description: Users with access right ACCESS_ACTUATOR are allowed to access /actuator/** path

policies.name: Reload Authorization Rules by System-Admin
policies.description: Users with access right RELOAD_AUTH_RULES are allowed to access /uaa-authorization/reloadRules path

policies.name: User Has ASSISTANT_WRITE Right For The System's Own Definition
policies.description: The system's own definition -- Assistant_DM and Operation_DM -- is written by the User only; the Runtime reads it (D-007a, ADR-0019). Operation_DM is guarded here because an Operation is a Thing, and an Assistant able to edit the catalogue could untick requiresApproval on the Operation that moves money. The access right is still ASSISTANT_WRITE: a second right would have been more precise and was refused as speculative granularity in a single-household system. The Data Service checks the three document write scopes with three different resource shapes, so all three are recognised here: the model name alone (checkDocumentCreatePermissionByModel, the cheap pre-check in DefaultDocumentService), the DocumentV2 being created, and the DocumentUpdateResource carrying the old and new document. Any other shape falls through to 'not a guarded model', so an unforeseen call path can never be denied by this rule.
rules: hasAccessRight('ASSISTANT_WRITE') or !({'Assistant_DM','Operation_DM'}.contains(#resource instanceof T(java.lang.String) ? #resource : (#resource instanceof T(com.mgmtp.a12.kernel.md.document.apiV2.immutable.DocumentV2) ? #resource.getDocumentModelId() : null)) or (#resource instanceof T(com.mgmtp.a12.dataservices.authorization.DocumentUpdateResource) and ({'Assistant_DM','Operation_DM'}.contains(#resource.getNewDocument()?.getDocumentModelId()) or {'Assistant_DM','Operation_DM'}.contains(#resource.getOldDocument()?.getDocumentModelId()))))

permissions.name: Actuator Access Permission
permissions.description: Control actuator accessibility by relative URL

permissions.name: System Definition Write Permission
permissions.description: Withholds Assistant_DM and Operation_DM -- the system's own definition -- from every role without ASSISTANT_WRITE, which is the `runtime` role. The right's name is narrower than its job, which is the accepted cost of reusing ASSISTANT_WRITE rather than minting OPERATION_WRITE. `call-parent-scope` defaults to true, so the parent definition's DOCUMENT_CREATE / DOCUMENT_UPDATE / DOCUMENT_PARTIAL_UPDATE checks still run and every permission on the scope must pass.
